I used a personality test on August 18th. The test itself was only $2 but I’ve now received two recurring payments for $39.95. When I reached out to the company that I did the test with, Personality Co, they said that they have no connection to Nordica labs, the company that was charging my account. I’ve never used a company called Nordica labs, nor even heard the name prior to this experience. When I went to PayPal to dispute the claim, they said there was no unauthorized activity.
I further researched the issue and all I am seeing is other customers having the same experience of being opted into a subscription even if you canceled the membership or never had one.
